headline: Japanese bonds out of control, will Taiwan be hit? Data laid out: the real test is in this Asian powerhouse - Finance
summary: Commentary in Taiwan questions whether turmoil in the yen and Japanese bonds will drag Taiwan down, citing exchange-rate and bond-yield changes. The analysis compares Japan's position with mainland China's.
why: Japanese government bond yields and the yen influence global capital flows, carry trades and borrowing costs across Asian markets.
